definitions.explanation: Used to count flat, thin objects such as paper, plates, shirts, tickets, photos, CDs, and sliced items.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三枚|さんまい}⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are three sheets of paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{五枚|ごまい}⟦{撮|と}りました→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧⟦{持|も}っています→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many shirts do you have?

examples.japanese: ⟦お{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{四枚|よんまい}⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{百枚|ひゃくまい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}せたい→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I took as many as a hundred photos on my trip, so I want to show them to my friends.

notes:
〜{枚|まい} is a counter for thin, flat objects. One of the most common counters in Japanese.

WHAT IT COUNTS:
- ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧: paper
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧: photos
- ⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧: plates
- ⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧: tickets
- ⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧: shirts and other flat-folding garments
- ⟦CD→CD：08847_shiidii⟧, ⟦DVD→DVD：08848_diibuidii⟧
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧: futons
- ⟦ピザ→ピザ：06769_piza⟧ (slices)

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- ⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧, ⟦{二枚|にまい}→二枚：30347_nimai⟧, {三枚|さんまい}, {四枚|よんまい}, {五枚|ごまい}
- {六枚|ろくまい}, {七枚|ななまい}, {八枚|はちまい}, {九枚|きゅうまい}, {十枚|じゅうまい}
- ⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧: how many (flat things)?

No sound changes occur with this counter.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦〜{冊|さつ}→〜冊：00666_satsu⟧ takes over once the paper is bound: loose sheets are ⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧, a notebook is ⟦{一冊|いっさつ}→一冊：23149_issatsu⟧.
- ⟦〜{本|ほん}→〜本：00688_hon⟧ is the shape opposite — long and thin rather than wide and thin. A rolled-up poster is still ⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧, because what matters is the object's own shape, not how it is stored.
- ⟦〜{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ is the fallback for small objects with no clear flat dimension.
